scope: Full-manuscript import and structural verification for 75 essays. Selected complete readings (one in each language), Chinese-source opening/section/conclusion comparisons, targeted cross-language factual/editorial checks, and browser testing. Not an exhaustive sentence-by-sentence linguistic review of all 75 manuscripts, nor a frame-by-frame viewing of the films.

preservation.full_text: All supplied numbered essay sections retained; no summary replacement.

Rendered series indexes: omit delivery-package language furniture and redundant language prefixes, retain all three chapter links. The same cleanup removes one obsolete edition label from the previously published Leon French index.
delivery_corrections_retained: Spirited Away: coercion before signature, one needed bath token before the later handful, gold before swallowing the frog, Chihiro remembering the river and Haku supplying his full name.
Life Is Beautiful: crowd awaiting the king, corrected soap/button comic paraphrase; adult narration is not evidence of an absence of trauma.
Interstellar: Mann's data fabrication predates awakening; station named in honor of Murph; Murph's decades of work are not placed after Brand's death.
Inception: years of emotional estrangement are distinct from the recent unfinished deathbed word; the ending remains undecided.
Schindler's List: cinematic compression of several lists, very low historical armaments production rather than absolute zero, descendants count dated to the film's 1993 horizon.
